mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (user_id, user_name, file_name, file_path, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, user_name, file_name, file_path, status, create_time, update_time FROM book WHERE user_name = #{userName} AND file_name = #{fileName} ORDER BY update_time DESC
